name: Hirono (Iwate, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hirono town emblem in green and blue: a green and blue ring crossed by a wavy line.
history: Municipal flag of Hirono, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Hirono town emblem — a green and blue ring crossed by a wavy line
